analyzed: evam pāramārthikam bodhi cittam catur aṅgam uddiśya parikaram āha repheṇa ityādi viśva vajram yathā ruci vipulataram ādhāra svabhāvam prākārakam pañjara bandhanam ca iti vajra prākāram vajra pañjaram sīmābandham ca iti

analyzed: tatra tad vipula raśmi avabhāsataḥ paritas jvālā mayam sīmābandham tad madhya avasthita bīja nirjāta vajra visaraiḥ ghana nibiḍa niścala avasthitaiḥ vajra prākāram vajra pañjaram ca bhāvayet

original: śūnyatābodhyanantaro 'yaṃ parikaraḥ | prathamakaraṇīyaṃ parikaram āha | prathamam ityādi | mṛtakaḥ śavaḥ | nirātmakatvād dharma(250r/503)dhātudyotakatvena dharmadhātvātmakaḥ | sthitveti sthitam ātmānam adhimucya | prajñopāyātmakam iti | śūnyatākaruṇābodhicittasvabhāvatvāt tasya | so 'yaṃ yathāyogaṃ yogānantarasādhāraṇo vidhiḥ |
analyzed: śūnyatā bodhi anantaraḥ yam parikaraḥ prathama karaṇīyam parikaram āha prathamam ityādi mṛtakaḥ śavaḥ nirātmaka tvāt dharma dhātu dyotaka tvena dharma dhātu ātmakaḥ sthitvā iti sthitam ātmānam adhimucya prajñā upāya ātmakam iti śūnyatā karuṇā bodhi citta svabhāva tvāt tasya saḥ yam yathāyogam yoga anantara sādhāraṇaḥ vidhiḥ

original: herukakramam adhikṛtyāha | hūṁkārād ityādi | vajrasaṃbhavaṃ vajrasyotpattiḥ | varaṭo madhyagolaḥ | hūṁkāra eva tattvam | dveṣātmakaṃ duṣṭānāṃ doṣakṣayāya kṛtrimakrodharasam | vajrajanmam iti hevajram | (250v/504) śraddhayeti rucyā | nīlaṃ nīlāruṇacchāyaṃ vā mahākaruṇārāgasūcanārtham |

original: evaṃ jhaṭiti herukarūpam ātmānaṃ vibhāvya viśodhitenātmanā svahṛdbījakiraṇākṛṣṭaṃ vyomni bhaṭṭārakaṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayed aṣṭadevībhiḥ svahṛdbījanirgatābhiḥ | mṛgalāñchanaḥ śaśī | mārtaṇḍo 'ruṇaḥ | bhaiṣajyaṃ vairocanaḥ | vajraṃ māṃsam | gandhahastetupāṭhe tu gandho 'tra māṃsam | yad vakṣyati | māṃsapūrṇakapālam iti | raso madyam |

original: śūnyatābodhim uddiṣṭāṃ nirdiśati | tata ityādi | padaṃ vyavasāyo vikalpas tena vinirmuktaṃ virahaḥ śūnyatvam | sarvadharmā ātmāno yasya tat sarvadharmātmakaṃ bhavet | śaraṇagamanādikaṃ tv atra noddiṣṭam adhimātrāṇām atrādhikārāt | tais tu maṇḍalapraveśata eva (251v/506) suvihitatvād asya sarvasya tathaiva dhāraṇāt |
analyzed: śūnyatā bodhim uddiṣṭām nirdiśati tatas ityādi padam vyavasāyaḥ vikalpaḥ tena vinirmuktam virahaḥ śūnyatvam sarva dharmāḥ ātmānaḥ yasya tat sarva dharma ātmakam bhavet śaraṇa gamana ādikam tu atra na uddiṣṭam adhimātrāṇām atra adhikārāt taiḥ tu maṇḍala praveśataḥ eva su vihita tvāt asya sarvasya tathā eva dhāraṇāt

original: tathāpi teṣām apy avipraṇāśārthaṃ mṛdūnāṃ cānugrahārthaṃ tantrāntarād avatārayitavyam | tadanantaraṃ brahmavihārā bhāvanīyāḥ | tataḥ śūnyatā | tato vajrapañjaram | ayaṃ ca kramo yogāntare 'pi yathāyogaṃ vijñeyaḥ | bījacihne tatpariṇateṣṭadevatāmūrtir iṣṭadevatā ca pūjyetyādi viśeṣāḥ nūhyāḥ (anne: viśeṣā ūhyāḥ) |
analyzed: tathā api teṣām api a vipraṇāśa artham mṛdūnām ca anugraha artham tantra antarāt avatārayitavyam tad anantaram brahmavihārāḥ bhāvanīyāḥ tatas śūnyatā tatas vajrapañjaram ayam ca kramaḥ yoga antare yathāyogam vijñeyaḥ bīja cihne tad pariṇata iṣṭadevatā mūrtiḥ iṣṭadevatā ca pūjyā ityādi viśeṣāḥ nūhyāḥ anne viśeṣāḥ ūhyāḥ

original: tadanantaraṃ vajrapañjarodare dhagiti paridṛṣṭāṣṭa(252r/507)śmaśānamadhye viśvadalakamalakarṇikāsthitaśavahṛdayopari sūryāsane yad dhyeyaṃ tad āha | candrālir ityādi | candrarūpeṇa pariṇatā āliś candrāliḥ | kālipariṇataḥ sūryaḥ kālimārtaṇḍaḥ | bījaṃ hūṁkāro raviśaśisaṃpuṭamadhye dhyeyaḥ |
analyzed: tad anantaram vajra pañjara udare dhak iti paridṛṣṭa aṣṭa śmaśāna madhye viśva dala kamala karṇikā sthita śava hṛdaya upari sūrya āsane yat dhyeyam tat āha candra āliḥ ityādi candra rūpeṇa pariṇatā āliḥ candra āliḥ kāli pariṇataḥ sūryaḥ kāli mārtaṇḍaḥ bījam hūṃ ākāraḥ ravi śaśi saṃpuṭa madhye dhyeyaḥ

original: tad eva bījaṃ sattvaṃ mātāpitṛcandrasūryāntarālavarti paramānandasvabhāvam āhuḥ | sa evātra sahajārtho bhāvyata ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: tat eva bījam sattvam mātā pitṛ candra sūrya antarāla varti paramānanda svabhāvam āhuḥ saḥ eva atra sahaja arthaḥ bhāvyate iti arthaḥ

original: svadehābhā iti | tadbīja(252v/508)pariṇatavajravaraṭakasthabījād dhevajradehasaṃnibhās tadvan nīlavarṇāḥ krodharasā jagadvinayanopāyabhūtā devatādehāḥ | hṛdaya iti bīje | pañcākārābhisaṃbodhikramayojanāpy atra vakṣyamāṇā boddhavyā |
analyzed: sva deha ābhāḥ iti tad bīja 252v508 pariṇata vajra varaṭaka stha bījāt hevajra deha saṃnibhāḥ tadvat nīla varṇāḥ krodha rasāḥ jagat vinayana upāya bhūtāḥ devatā dehāḥ hṛdaye iti bīje pañca ākāra abhisaṃbodhi krama yojanā api atra vakṣyamāṇā boddhavyā

original: evaṃ candrasūryavajrabījapariṇāmeṇa dveṣātmako hevajraḥ paramānandamayaḥ svasvabījajanitaparivārasahita evopajāyate | khadhātv ityādi | nīlāruṇābham ityanto granthaḥ (253r/509) sarvadharmātmakaṃ bhaved ity anantaraṃ boddhavyaḥ | hūṁkārajaṃ vajram iti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: evam candra sūrya vajra bīja pariṇāmeṇa dveṣa ātmakaḥ hevajraḥ paramānanda mayaḥ sva sva bīja janita parivāra sahitaḥ eva upajāyate kha dhātu ityādi nīla aruṇa ābham iti antaḥ granthaḥ sarva dharma ātmakam bhavet iti anantaram boddhavyaḥ hūṃkāra jam vajram iti śeṣaḥ

original: kīdṛśaṃ hevajraṃ bhāvayed ity āha | sarvetyādi | alaṅkārāḥ śiraḥsthapañcakapālacakrīkuṇḍalakarṇīrucakamekhalābhasmārdranaraśiromālāḥ | paridhānaṃ vyāghracarma tac ca saprajñatve paścādbhāga eva | vāmorau dakṣiṇacaraṇāsraṃ saṃsthāpyārdhaparyaṅkiṇam | netrāṇi raktāni vartulāni | bhairavo (253v/510) bhīṣaṇamūrtiḥ śavaḥ |
analyzed: kīdṛśam hevajram bhāvayet iti āha sarva ityādi alaṅkārāḥ śiraḥ stha pañca kapāla cakrī kuṇḍala karṇī rucaka mekhalā bhasma ārdra nara śiraḥ mālāḥ paridhānam vyāghra carma tat ca sa prajña tve paścādbhāge eva vāma ūrau dakṣiṇa caraṇa asram saṃsthāpya ardha paryaṅkiṇam netrāṇi raktāni vartulāni bhairavaḥ bhīṣaṇa mūrtiḥ śavaḥ

original: vajrakhaṭvāṅgaṃ yajñopavītavad gṛhītam | kapālaṃ mahāraktapūrṇaṃ vajrāṅkitam | kṛṣṇavajraṃ pañcasūkaṃ jvālāmāli samullālitam | uccāraṇātmakam uccāraṇaśīlam |
analyzed: vajra khaṭvāṅgam yajñopavīta vat gṛhītam kapālam mahā rakta pūrṇam vajra aṅkitam kṛṣṇa vajram pañca sūkam jvālā māli samullālitam uccāraṇa ātmakam uccāraṇa śīlam

original: śmaśāna iti vasanty asminn iti vasanaṃ nivāsaḥ | śavānaṃ vasanaṃ śmaśānam iti | pūrvabhāge 'vabhāgasya matvam | uttarapade vasabhāgasya śābhāvaḥ | nirukto na (anne: nairuktena) varṇavikāreṇa | tatra teṣāṃ (254r/511) vāsakriyā | caṅkramaṇasthānaśayananiṣadyāḥ | kabandhodbaddhaśāyitaśūlabhinnādīnāṃ yathākramam | ayam abhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: śmaśāne iti vasanti asmin iti vasanam nivāsaḥ śavānam vasanam śmaśānam iti pūrva bhāge va bhāgasya matvam uttara pade vasa bhāgasya śa abhāvaḥ niruktaḥ na anne nairuktena varṇa vikāreṇa tatra teṣām vāsa kriyā caṅkramaṇa sthāna śayana niṣadyāḥ kabandha udbaddha śāyita śūla bhinna ādīnām yathākramam ayam abhiprāyaḥ

original: yathā śmaśāne nirātmakāḥ śavāḥ tathā sarvatreti nirātmakasarvasattvā vāsāḥ śmaśānam | sattvāḥ sattvasvabhāvena śūnyāḥ sattvāvāsā api sattvāvāsasvabhāvena śūnyā iti śmaśānārthaḥ | atas tasminn evālaye nirālambanamahākṛpāmahāprajñātmakamahābodhicitta(254v/512)mahāmudrāsvabhāvasya bhagavataḥ krīḍā yujyata iti |
analyzed: yathā śmaśāne nirātmakāḥ śavāḥ tathā sarvatra iti nirātmaka sarva sattvāḥ vāsāḥ śmaśānam sattvāḥ sattva svabhāvena śūnyāḥ sattva āvāsāḥ api sattva āvāsa svabhāvena śūnyāḥ iti śmaśāna arthaḥ atas tasmin eva ālaye nirālambana mahākṛpā mahāprajñā ātmaka mahā bodhi citta 254v512 mahāmudrā svabhāvasya bhagavataḥ krīḍā yujyate iti

original: devyo vajraraudryādayaḥ | ataḥ ṣoḍaśadevīparivṛtaḥ | evaṃ caturbhujaṣaḍbhujayor api niṣpattiḥ | viśeṣaś ca tantrokto draṣṭavyaḥ |
analyzed: devyaḥ vajraraudrī ādayaḥ atas ṣoḍaśa devī parivṛtaḥ evam caturbhuja ṣaḍbhujayoḥ api niṣpattiḥ viśeṣaḥ ca tantra uktaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: kavacādayaś ca vakṣyamāṇā boddhavyāḥ |

original: evam api dvibhujabhāvanāyāṃ mahāmudrāsiddhiḥ saṃbhavaty eva | prastāve paryante ca mudrāyogānusmaraṇān nairātmyābhāvanāyām iva |
analyzed: evam api dvi bhuja bhāvanāyām mahāmudrā siddhiḥ saṃbhavati eva prastāve paryante ca mudrā yoga anusmaraṇāt nairātmya abhāvanāyām iva

original: (255r/513) tathā hi saparikarasya bhagavato niṣpattau kavacādijñānasattvapraveśābhiṣekamudraṇapūjāstutyamṛtāsvādānanantaram atipramuditā yoginyaḥ kaṭākṣekṣaṇastutivyājeṅgitābhidhānādinā bhāvam upadarśayantyo 'nurāgodrekād romodgamakampanādiprāptā bhagavantam upetya puruṣāyitam anutiṣṭhanti |
analyzed: tathā hi sa parikarasya bhagavataḥ niṣpattau kavaca ādi jñāna sattva praveśa abhiṣeka mudraṇa pūjā stuti amṛta āsvāda anantaram ati pramuditāḥ yoginyaḥ kaṭākṣa īkṣaṇa stuti vyāja iṅgita abhidhāna ādinā bhāvam upadarśayantyaḥ nurāga udrekāt roma udgama kampana ādi prāptāḥ bhagavantam upetya puruṣāyitam anutiṣṭhanti

original: tataḥ prathamataḥ pṛthvīvajrā samāśliṣyati tatas tadaparās tām anupraviśantīti sahajamahāsukham uddīpa(255v/514)yaty eva prastāve | anyeṣv api yathāyogam ayaṃ kramo boddhavyaḥ | iti saṃkṣepato vidhiḥ |
analyzed: tatas prathamatas pṛthvī vajrā samāśliṣyati tatas tad aparāḥ tām anupraviśanti iti sahaja mahā sukham eva prastāve anyeṣu api yathāyogam ayam kramaḥ boddhavyaḥ iti saṃkṣepataḥ vidhiḥ

original: madhyas tu dharmodayāntarabjaviśvavajrasthakūṭāgārodare śavādibhāvanāyāṃ pūrvavat | savistaras tu madhyabhāvanānantaraṃ samāṇḍaleyamaṇḍaleśaniṣpattau ṣoḍaśabhujavad drutāpattyādikramato jñātavyaḥ | trailokyākṣepaś ca bhagavān nairātmyāsamāpanna unneyakāsyeti kecid guravaḥ | mukhyatas tu saṃkṣiptavi(256r/515)dhyadhikāreṇa herukāḥ |
analyzed: madhyaḥ tu dharma udaya antar abja viśva vajra stha kūṭāgāra udare śava ādi bhāvanāyām pūrvavat sa vistaraḥ tu madhya bhāvanā anantaram sama āṇḍaleya maṇḍala īśa niṣpattau ṣoḍaśa bhuja vat druta āpatti ādi kramataḥ jñātavyaḥ trailokya ākṣepaḥ ca bhagavān nairātmya a samāpannaḥ unneyakā asya iti kecid guravaḥ mukhyatas tu saṃkṣipta vidhi adhikāreṇa herukāḥ

original: madhyavidhyadhikāreṇa nairātmyāmaṇḍalam | adhimātravidher adhikāreṇāṣṭāsyamaṇḍalam iti | sarvasāmṛtam iti sarvayogānāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ pūrakatayāmṛtaṃ vidhim |
analyzed: madhya vidhi adhikāreṇa adhimātra vidheḥ adhikāreṇa aṣṭa āsya maṇḍalam iti sarva sā amṛtam iti sarva yogānām vakṣyamāṇānām pūraka tayā amṛtam vidhim

original: caturbhujasya viśeṣaṃ vaktum āha | sa evetyādi | caturānandasvabhāvaś caturṇām ānandānām ekarasatayodayāt | tatsvabhāvatvena caturmārāṇāṃ nirjayo viśuddhiḥ | tayā ca caturbhujatvam | samāliṅgitavigraham i(256v/516)ti samāliṅgitaḥ prajñāyā vigrahaḥ śarīraṃ tena taṃ bhāvayet |
analyzed: caturbhujasya viśeṣam vaktum āha saḥ eva ityādi catur ānanda svabhāvaḥ caturṇām ānandānām ekarasa tayā udayāt tad svabhāva tvena catur mārāṇām nirjayaḥ viśuddhiḥ tayā ca caturbhuja tvam samāliṅgita vigraham samāliṅgitaḥ prajñāyāḥ vigrahaḥ śarīram tena tam bhāvayet

original: ṣaḍbhujasya viśeṣaṃ vaktum āha | prathamam ityādi | śūnyam iti | upalakṣaṇaṃ śeṣavidheḥ | niṣkalo vajrasattvaḥ | paramārthataḥ sarvaprapañcarahitatvena kalayitum aśakyatvāt | katham ity āha | candretyādi | hūṁkārasya ṣaḍbhujabhāvanāyām eva hetuvajradhararūpatvāc candramaṇḍalitvam | phalarūpās tu trayo 'pi herukāḥ sūryamaṇḍalinaḥ |
analyzed: ṣaḍbhujasya viśeṣam vaktum āha prathamam ityādi śūnyam iti upalakṣaṇam śeṣa vidheḥ niṣkalaḥ vajra sattvaḥ paramārthataḥ sarva prapañca rahita tvena kalayitum aśakya tvāt katham iti āha candra ityādi hūṃ ākārasya ṣaḍbhuja bhāvanāyām eva hetu vajradhara rūpa tvāt candra maṇḍali tvam phala rūpāḥ tu trayaḥ pi herukāḥ sūrya maṇḍalinaḥ
